name_input: KONZEPT ENERGY SERVICES INDIA PRIVATE LIMTED
export_evidence: ImportKey page (slug konzept-energy-services-india-private-limited) reports "Total Shipments 529 Records detected" and "Latest Cargo 2026-02-10", but every one of the 5 visible rows is an INBOUND shipment into India, e.g. "2026-02-07 | KONZEPT ENERGY SERVICES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | CAMERON (SINGAPORE) PTE LTD | INDUSTRIAL VALVE - 1.5 FORGED GLOBE VALVE- | CHENNAI AIR CARGO ACC INMAA4, India | SINGAPORE | 84818030 | 9468877" — i.e. the company is the Indian importer/buyer, not the shipper. No outbound (India -> foreign destination) bill of lading with date, destination and HS code was seen in any accessible record. Source counter: ImportKey claims 529 shipments; rows actually seen = 5, all imports. Second slug variant /konzept-energy-services-india-pvt-ltd returned an empty paywalled page (0 rows). volza, eximpedia and trademo returned HTTP 403 and could not be read.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403, and the web_search tool was unavailable for the whole session (searx connection refused), so no domestic-supply record was located. Absence here is a retrieval gap, not proof of no domestic supply.
note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION FINDING: the customs trail that does exist is import-side only. The company appears in Indian customs data as the consignee buying valves and pumps from Cameron (Singapore), UNP Polyvalves USA, Bray Controls Peru, Valvtronic S.A. (Argentina) and Ryan Herco Flow Solutions (US), across ports Nhava Sheva Sea, Ahmedabad Air, Chennai Air Cargo and Houston. Declared HS 848180/848190 matches the observed commodity (84818030 industrial/globe/ball/plug valves) — HS is consistent, no correction needed. However, no evidence of the company itself exporting or of domestic supply was found: 'следов поставок не найдено' on the export side. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any accessible source, not estimated. PAN AAFCK6870L and the Anna Nagar, Chennai (Tamil Nadu) address are as claimed but were not independently verified against a registry (registries out of scope; zaubacorp blocked). Per project rules the company is not rejected — it is a legitimate operating importer/trader of oil-gas valves; role likely trader/distributor rather than manufacturer, but role was not the object of this check. Recommend a paid Volza/Eximpedia export-side lookup and a GST/GeM check before any supply decision.
